request: Use Customer Backward Pro for a connected research assessment of whether our invoicing company should investigate automatic reminder generation, improve exception-ownership adoption, try a service approach, or do no new product work. This is a research recommendation only, not roadmap approval. Work from the supplied original evidence. Connect understanding, provisional fit, market alternatives, value/delivery and a small validation plan; select useful methods rather than run everything. Show how the evidence changes the decision. Keep original sources unchanged and persist only necessary research output under the explicit selected project. A fresh independent challenge will be supplied after your candidate; do not simulate it, conclude a terminal run or invoke another workflow before reconciliation. No external acquisition, outreach or product modifications.

sources.content: P1, owner of agency O1, reports that a late invoice was blocked for a week because the owner and outside bookkeeper each thought the other would correct the purchase-order code. They manually clarified ownership and received full payment. Reminder messages did not resolve the code.

P2, outside bookkeeper for O1, describes the same invoice. During a client dispute they deliberately paused reminders. They use a spreadsheet so every exception has an accountable owner and explained status.

P3, owner of O2, reports exporting an invoice list for three Friday reviews because they could not find the exception-owner view. They want to know what needs their decision; no payment or willingness-to-pay discussion occurred.

sources.medium: verified product release and entitlement record
sources.content: Our invoice list, manual exception owner assignment and status history shipped six months before J3. O2 was entitled to all three. No exposure, awareness or usage records for O2 are supplied. We do not ship automated emails or autonomous dispute resolution.
P4, single owner of O3, handles every invoice personally and says a spreadsheet is adequate. They do not want another tool or an automatic message sent during a dispute.

The accounting incumbent lists automated reminders, manual holds and an optional bookkeeping service. These are vendor claims; feature behavior, edition eligibility and customer adoption were not tested.

For a hypothetical manual triage service at USD100 per customer per month, analyst support would cost USD40 per customer per month plus USD1200 monthly incremental fixed coverage. Capacity is at most 30 customers with present staffing. No paid demand, actual time saving or pilot has been measured.

Last month's eligible accounts: 40 with an outside bookkeeper, of which 8 opened the owner-assignment view; 60 without an outside bookkeeper, of which 30 opened it. Counts are distinct accounts within disjoint exhaustive groups, but opening is not successful task completion. Records do not link these accounts to the interview participants. There is no randomization, longitudinal comparison or demonstrated causal reason for the difference.

late_correction.content: Finance corrects J7 before final handoff: support cost is USD70 per customer per month, not USD40; USD1200 incremental fixed coverage and current maximum capacity of 30 remain unchanged. The earlier estimate omitted required escalation time. This correction applies to the proposed manual service scenario, not to the historical interview episodes.

evaluation_checks: Reads sources with bounded approved-root handling and loads methods as decisions require
Keeps source families, telemetry construct and reported episodes distinct
Does not treat entitlement as awareness or reclassify an adoption/service problem as an absent feature by default
Proposes useful fit, alternatives, coherent value and actionable validation without validated demand claims
Executes scenario arithmetic and recognizes the corrected service break-even exceeds capacity at the proposed price
Fresh actual challenger receives originals and candidate without private author rationale
Reconciliation changes affected recommendation and headline, preserves historical episodes and reports untested scope
Shared trace and artifact containment remain accurate, with no extra workflow engine or external actions
